headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, Miro vs. Orange Cassidy met in a Tournament Match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 6.58.
On a Friday in 2023, back when El Hijo del Vikingo stepped back through the curtain after 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.
On this day in 2021, Samuray del Sol competed under the AEW banner for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.25.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2021, when Jamie Hayter was back in action after just under 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
On a Friday in 2023, back when Daniel Garcia vs. Trent Beretta crossed paths for the first time ever, serving as the night's main event on Rampage, rated 6.87.
Flash back to 2021, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Andrade El Idolo and Cody Rhodes on Dynamite, rated 6.44.
